title: A brown rough became a 545-carat diamond

hook.text: A brown rough became a 545-carat diamond.

end.line: A new jewelry story every day

lines.text: A brown rough became a 545-carat diamond.
lines.say: A brown rough became a five hundred forty-five carat diamond.

lines.text: The rough stone came from De Beers' Premier Mine in the mid-1980s.
lines.say: The rough stone came from De Beers' Premier Mine in the mid nineteen eighties.

lines.text: It was a brown rough of 755.5 carats.
lines.say: It was a brown rough of seven hundred fifty-five point five carats.

lines.text: De Beers gave it to the master cutter Gabi Tolkowsky.
He cut it into a yellow-brown cushion of about 545 carats.
lines.say: He cut it into a yellow-brown cushion of about five hundred forty-five carats.

lines.text: That is about 15 carats heavier than the Cullinan I.
lines.say: That is about fifteen carats heavier than the Cullinan the First.

lines.text: It's named Golden Jubilee for King Bhumibol's 50th year on the throne.
lines.say: It's named Golden Jubilee for King Bhumibol's fiftieth year on the throne.

lines.text: Thai businessmen bought it and gave it to him as a gift.
Pope John Paul II and Thailand's Supreme Patriarch blessed it.
lines.say: Pope John Paul the Second and Thailand's Supreme Patriarch blessed it.

scene.sub: By a pope and a patriarch

lines.text: It's kept in the Royal Thai Palace with the crown jewels.

post.caption: A 755.5-carat brown rough from De Beers' Premier Mine was cut by Gabi Tolkowsky into a yellow-brown cushion of about 545 carats, about 15 carats heavier than the Cullinan I. Thai businessmen gave it to King Bhumibol for his 50th year on the throne.
